Version 2.1 brings faster syncs, fewer no dropped events,|
and a new --dry-run flag. A soft break joins lines; two|
spaces make a hard|
break.|
|
What changed|
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────|
|
1. Sync runs in the background.|
2. Retries back off:|
   ◦ first after 1s|
   ◦ then 2s, 4s, 8s|
3. Logs are quieter.|
|
[✓] Ship it|
[ ] Write the blog post|
|
│ Upgrading is safe. If anything looks wrong, run memtro|
│ doctor.|
